items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Tony Saunders (son of Merle Saunders) and states 'I’m still in touch with him', but the person to judge is 'Saunders' (likely referring to the previously mentioned Merle Saunders or the general name). ctx.x: He wrote tunes. He lives on royalties now. The bass player was Tony . . .
Yes, Tony Saunders, who came from Merle Saunders. They’re father and son, very famous in the Oakland area, funky as could be. I’m still in touch with him.
